evidence.locator: The MOVE instruction transfers data from RAM to a register destination.
evidence.claim: Copper MOVE writes the second instruction word to the register selected by the first word.

evidence.claim: COP1LC selects the list and COPJMP1 restarts execution from it.

firmware.guidance: Supply a legally obtained Amiga Kickstart 1.3 ROM. The ROM is never copied into the report.

relock_history.why: Two independent, deliberate upstream changes. Build198x 1f06f83 fixed the ADF file-header protection field, which this disk had as 0x0d — active-low RWED, so read, write and delete were all DENIED. KS1.3 ignores those bits so the disk still booted and the frame is byte-identical either way; KS2.0+ enforces them, which is the boot that fix repaired. Only two bytes of the ADF change: the protection field and the block checksum that follows from it. Separately, Emu198x 4d6b00d9 'Correct Amiga Copper horizontal comparison' and the programmable-HBLANK work moved where a Copper colour change lands at the right edge: 236 pixels of 442,368 (0.05%), all in the last 18 columns, blue nibble 8 becoming nibble F.
relock_history.verification: Both old revisions were rebuilt from clean checkouts and reproduce the previous hashes exactly, so nothing was broken — the lock was stale, not the tools. The ADF change was proven not to affect the frame by rendering both disks on both emulator revisions.
